title.en: Chapter 8 — The Sign of the Spy-glass

sentences.en: Trelawney sent me to the ship’s cook.

sentences.ar: اسمه جون سيلفر وعنده دكان صغير.
sentences.en: His name was John Silver and he had a small shop.

sentences.ar: لما فتّ، شفته وقف على إجر وحدة.
sentences.en: When I went in, I saw him standing on one leg.
I remembered the old sailor’s words and went cold.

sentences.ar: بس سيلفر ضحك وحكى معي بلطف.
sentences.en: But Silver laughed and spoke to me kindly.
After an hour, I liked him.
And that was my first mistake.
